mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONTENT_ID, C.CONTENT_TITLE, C.CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE FROM CONTENT C RIGHT JOIN ENTERTAINMENT USING(CONTENT_ID) ORDER BY CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONTENT_ID, C.CONTENT_TITLE, C.CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE FROM CONTENT C RIGHT JOIN MOVIE USING(CONTENT_ID) ORDER BY CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY)UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONTENT_ID, C.CONTENT_TITLE, C.CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE FROM CONTENT C RIGHT JOIN DOCUMENTARY USING(CONTENT_ID) ORDER BY CONTENT_UPLOAD_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY)
